items.name: utils
items.title: Utils
items.description: The cn helper for merging Tailwind classes.

items.name: bounce-sidebar
items.title: Bounce Sidebar
items.description: A vertical navigation list with a bouncy, spring-animated active indicator.

items.name: family-drawer
items.title: Family Drawer
items.description: A drawer that opens from the right side of the screen, with a family tree structure inside. It supports color and size (sm/md/lg) props.

items.name: proximity-sidebar
items.title: Proximity Sidebar
items.description: A dash-style scroll sidebar whose items expand as the pointer approaches.

items.name: scroll-progress
items.title: Scroll Progress
items.description: A scroll progress pill that tracks reading position and expands into a squircle menu of sections you can jump to.

items.name: code-block
items.title: Code Block
items.description: A clean code block that builds its entire theme from a single accent color. Pass code and a hex, it does the rest.

items.name: otp-input
items.title: OTP Input
items.description: A one-time-code input whose characters roll into place behind a caret that slides from slot to slot.

items.name: magnetic-dock
items.title: Magnetic Dock
items.description: A dock that responds to cursor movement with a magnetic effect.

items.name: flickering-grid
items.title: Flickering Grid
items.description: A grid that flickers with a subtle animation.

items.name: youtube-embed
items.title: Youtube Embed
items.description: A component to embed YouTube videos with customizable options.

items.name: github-calendar
items.title: GitHub Calendar
items.description: A fully customizable GitHub-style contributions heatmap for React.

items.name: lightboard
items.title: Light Board
items.description: A scrolling dot-matrix LED board that supports drawing and sketching.

items.name: animated-beam
items.title: Animated Beam
items.description: An animated SVG beam connecting UI elements with flowing gradient.

items.name: option-wheel
items.title: Option Wheel
